 # GHSA-SEED-0001
 
+This is an isolated synthetic advisory, not a real provider finding.
+
 Affected: requests < 2.32.0
-Fixed in: 2.32.0
-Severity: moderate
+Synthetic fixed threshold: 2.32.0
+Synthetic severity: moderate
+
+## Upgrade outcome
+
+Dependency: requests 2.31.0 -> 2.32.5 (reason: synthetic GHSA-SEED-0001).
+The unrelated idna==3.7 pin is unchanged.
+
+Breaking changes handled: none required for this fixture. The application's
+only Requests usage is reading requests.__version__. The compatibility review
+below uses the official upstream history supplied by the maintainer; no
+release notes were fetched locally.
+
+Lockfile: not applicable; this repository has only requirements.txt and no
+lockfile. The previously captured exact manifest pin is requests==2.32.5;
+idna==3.7 remains unchanged. Hosted CI verified pip resolution and installation
+with `python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt`. No package-manager command
+was run locally, and no lockfile was generated or hand-edited. Transitive
+resolutions remain unpinned and may vary across installations.
+
+Verified: initially, local execution-based verification was pending hosted CI.
+The task-specific checks are now observed as passed in hosted CI, as reported
+by the root maintainer who retrieved and checked the raw log. No local tests,
+scanners, application execution, installations, or network commands ran.
+Existing tests are preserved. This finalization changes only ADVISORY.md.
+
+## Observed hosted verification
+
+Evidence: [hosted Unit Tests run 40152952529](https://github.com/ravisingh11/ai-software-toolkit/actions/runs/40152952529),
+on toolkit PR source `f0b4e2e47623c51b59b41e67e3a78530aa8a28c8`.
+These checks applied the exact previously captured code outputs. The raw-log
+marker at `2026-10-25T02:14:03.6748232Z` states:
+
+> REAL_CLIENT_EVIDENCE dependency-upgrade: pip installation/check and tests passed; original synthetic advisory rejected
+
+- Installation/resolution, pip check, version imports, and the full existing
+  unit test suite passed in the hosted environment.
+- The synthetic originating advisory check (`python3 check_advisory.py`)
+  passed for the upgraded pin; the original 2.31.0 manifest was rejected.
+  This script checks only the synthetic manifest threshold, not installed
+  dependencies or real provider findings.
+- All five task-specific demonstration tests passed. The overall job failed
+  in two separate test_validate_skills fixture tests that assumed empty ledger
+  rows; the PR is fixing those assumptions. The overall job did not pass.
+- CI is external outcome evidence, not native attestation of agent identity.
+- Normal external dependency audit: unavailable/not applicable. No such audit
+  is configured for this isolated fixture; this is not a passing external
+  scan or proof that all dependencies are free of vulnerabilities.
+- No separate build command is defined in the seeded repository. Hosted
+  imports and tests establish compatibility only for that environment and
+  the fixture's limited behavior, not a runtime matrix or HTTP/TLS behavior.
+
+## Upstream compatibility review and residual risks
+
+Source: [official Requests history at v2.32.5](https://github.com/psf/requests/blob/v2.32.5/HISTORY.md),
+provided separately by the maintainer and reviewed from the supplied text.
+
+- Python support: 2.32.0 dropped CPython 3.7 and PyPy 3.7/3.8 and added
+  CPython 3.12 and PyPy 3.9/3.10. Version 2.32.4 dropped PyPy 3.9 and added
+  PyPy 3.11 on Linux/macOS. Version 2.32.5 dropped Python 3.8 and added
+  Python 3.14. The target therefore requires Python 3.9 or newer; deployment
+  on an older runtime requires a separate runtime decision. Hosted success
+  does not establish support for every declared upstream runtime.
+- Adapter changes: 2.32.2 introduced get_connection_with_tls_context for
+  custom HTTPAdapters; get_connection is deprecated from 2.32.0 onward.
+  Version 2.32.3 repaired custom SSLContext support in adapter subclasses and
+  operation on Python builds without ssl. This fixture defines no adapters
+  and only reads the version string, so no adapter migration is needed.
+- TLS changes: 2.32.0 fixed Session certificate-verification persistence
+  after an initial verify=False request and introduced global SSLContext
+  reuse. Version 2.32.5 reverted that caching feature because of operational
+  issues. The fixture makes no HTTP requests or TLS configuration changes;
+  neither TLS correctness nor cache behavior is exercised by its tests.
+- Version 2.32.4 also fixed CVE-2024-47081 involving netrc credentials for
+  crafted URLs. That upstream fix is distinct from GHSA-SEED-0001; the
+  synthetic check does not validate this real vulnerability or provider
+  advisory status. Response encoding, content-length, JSON decoding, and
+  packaging changes in the supplied history do not touch this fixture's
+  version-only use. Future Requests 2.33.0 build-system changes are outside
+  the pinned 2.32.5 scope.
+
+There are no application compatibility edits in this upgrade. Coverage
+remains limited to installation/imports, the existing version-string test,
+and the synthetic advisory threshold. No production HTTP behavior, external
+provider scan, broader dependency audit, or cross-platform/runtime matrix
+is established by this evidence.
+
+## Rollback
+
+Previous version: requests==2.31.0. From the repository root, the exact
+manifest rollback command is:
+
+```sh
+sed -i.bak 's/^requests==2.32.5$/requests==2.31.0/' requirements.txt
+```
+
+This leaves a requirements.txt.bak backup and keeps idna unchanged. Reinstall
+with `python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt` in the target environment
+when execution is permitted. Neither command was executed locally. There are
+no application data or configuration migrations in this change. Rolling back
+restores the pin affected by synthetic GHSA-SEED-0001.
